mapper.select: SELECT * FROM miniapp_user_keys WHERE openid_hash = #{openidHash} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM miniapp_user_keys WHERE user_key = #{userKey} AND enabled = 1 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO miniapp_user_keys (openid_hash, openid, user_key, key_preview, enabled, created_at, updated_at, last_used_at) VALUES (#{openidHash}, #{openid}, #{userKey}, #{keyPreview}, #{enabled}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{lastUsedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE miniapp_user_keys SET user_key = #{userKey}, key_preview = #{keyPreview}, enabled = #{enabled}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, last_used_at = #{lastUsedAt} WHERE openid_hash = #{openidHash}
